card.name: Linking words before irreversible-harm terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'a', 'become' and 'may' right before a worsening or lasting condition is named. Seen in warnings about tardive dyskinesia and kidney disease.

modes.label: Will become irreversible
modes.description: The verb 'become' after 'likelihood that it will' in tardive dyskinesia warnings.
modes.example: the likelihood that it will<< become>> irreversible are believed to increase as the duration

modes.label: May also occur
modes.description: The word 'may' after 'low dosages and' in tardive dyskinesia text.
modes.example: TD can develop after relatively brief treatment period at low dosages and<< may>> also occur after discontinuation of treatment.

modes.label: Progress to a
modes.description: The article 'a' after 'progress to' before a kidney syndrome.
modes.example: which can progress to<< a>> nephrotic syndrome.
